decisions.rationale: Artifact A is source-bound, instructionally precise, internally coherent, and has two uniquely correct assessments with discriminating choices and useful feedback. Artifact B has multiple critical defects, most decisively two incorrect declared answers that contradict its own explanations, along with duplicated alternatives, unsupported named examples, an overgeneralized condition, and no usable scenario decision.
